parsed.observations: A narrow green leaf blade has reddish-brown pustules scattered along its length. Several pustules are elongated and coalescing, with visibly split, ragged epidermal margins. No white powdery growth, necrotic blotches, or black dots are visible.
parsed.summary: The elongated brick-red pustules with ragged, ruptured epidermal margins on the leaf are most consistent with stem rust.
